retrievalProfile.description: Use this skill for high-energy urban music covers featuring a central subject against a solid vibrant red backdrop with arched, heavy-weight serif display text.
excludeWhen: requesting corporate or professional business layouts

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, low-angle studio portrait of a subject in expressive urban fashion, set against a seamless, saturated red background. The composition is framed by large, arched serif typography at the top and a fluid script signature in the bottom corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered and squatting to create a triangular base
Arched top text following the curve of the subject's head/hair
High-contrast lighting creating deep shadows on a monochromatic background
White accessories and text popping against a dominant red field
coreInvariants: Arched display typography at the top
High-contrast studio lighting with hard shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, occupying the middle 60% of the frame in a squatting pose.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, arched white serif text at the top serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the arched title, move down to the subject's face, and follow the vertical line of the body to the signature at the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space on the left and right sides of the subject, filled with solid red.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with high value (bright) foreground elements to ensure legibility.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavyweight slab-serif and fluid brush script
letterConstructionRules: Display text must be arched upward
Script text is slanted with varying stroke thickness
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'P' and 'S' in the main title have exaggerated, rounded curves.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy, structured slab serif for the title paired with a loose, organic script for the signature.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, rounded serif aesthetic of the main title.
Provides a similar energetic brush-script feel for the signature.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a person in urban fashion squatting against a solid, vibrant red seamless backdrop with high-contrast lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, arched heavyweight slab-serif title in cream at the top, and a white brush-script signature at the bottom left.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, saturated red?
Is the main font a heavy slab-serif?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the arch of the text does not obscure the subject's face.
Ensure the red background is uniform without distracting gradients.
Verify the script signature is legible against the red.
Confirm the lighting on the subject matches the intensity of the background color.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Subject + Saturated Red Backdrop + Arched Slab Serif Title + Script Signature Overlay
